name: CBHB
recent: CBH Engineering 近期获得一份价值 RM88.05 million 的 Selangor 数据中心合约，并有多项董事及大股东 Cheah Boon Hwa 的股权交易申报。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均大幅增长。
notable: 获得价值 RM88.05 million 的 Selangor 数据中心合约。
董事兼大股东 Cheah Boon Hwa 在公开市场及闭市期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 董事在闭市期间有买卖公司股份的申报。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM120.928 million，环比增长35.1%，同比增长102.6%；净利为 RM24.529 million，环比增长34.9%，同比增长142.7%；净利率为20.3%。

recent_en: CBH Engineering recently secured an RM88.05 million data centre contract in Selangor, alongside multiple filings on dealings by Director and substantial shareholder Cheah Boon Hwa. The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw significant growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Secured an RM88.05 million data centre contract in Selangor.
Director and substantial shareholder Cheah Boon Hwa acquired shares multiple times in the open market and during closed period.
risks_en: Filings show director dealings in the company's shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM120.928 million, up 35.1% QoQ and 102.6% YoY; net profit was RM24.529 million, up 34.9% QoQ and 142.7% YoY; net margin was 20.3%.
